description: The plot titled “Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset” illustrates how three evaluation metrics (precision, recall, and F1-score) vary across five MS-FSLHate model variants. The x-axis is a categorical axis labeled “Model Variants,” showing (from left to right) “Full model (Ours),” “w/o Prompt,” “w/o Augmentation,” “w/o Attention,” and “w/o Prompt & Augmentation,” with labels angled diagonally. The y-axis is labeled “Metric (%),” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from about 56 to 66 with regularly spaced tick marks at 58, 60, 62, 64, and 66. Precision is shown as a purple solid line with circular markers, moving from 65.43 at “Full model (Ours)” down to 61.06 at “w/o Prompt,” then up to 62.22 at “w/o Augmentation,” rising to 64.06 at “w/o Attention,” and ending at 65.44 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation.” Recall is shown as a blue solid line with circular markers, changing from 65.78 at “Full model (Ours)” to 59.64 at “w/o Prompt,” up to 63.77 at “w/o Augmentation,” down to 59.17 at “w/o Attention,” and reaching 56.82 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation.” F1-score is shown as a tan/brown solid line with circular markers, going from 65.56 at “Full model (Ours)” to 60.16 at “w/o Prompt,” up to 62.63 at “w/o Augmentation,” down to 59.67 at “w/o Attention,” and ending at 57.74 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation.”
